output.reason: The changelog line [ev-af8499647b78] on its own is vague. The upgrade-guide section fills the gap. It names the removed flags: -boltdb.shipper.shared-store, -tsdb.shipper.shared-store, their .key-prefix variants, and the compactor shared-store and key-prefix flags [ev-43cc6d389282][ev-3d75e7ce1720][ev-15a875cd9a39][ev-528edacf0d9e][ev-19d4f84472e6][ev-ca57f615b9c9][ev-cf8ca5687050]. It also says who is exposed: nobody who never set these options needs to change anything [ev-0483f04624d3][ev-76a46c52508c]. Setups are exposed if their shared-store value differs from period_config object_store for tsdb/boltdb-shipper periods, or if their key-prefix is not index/ [ev-7d2769e8c602][ev-af5a4b32c120][ev-8ceba924ad20][ev-632a3911583a]. The consequence is stated too: those setups lose access to the index for the mismatched periods until the index tables are moved or path_prefix is set, and the compactor now runs on every object store configured in period configs [ev-c569cd56f9ef].
